description: Tool execution policy for Hermes-orchestrated multi-agent work. Goal: MAXIMIZE auto-run, MINIMIZE human approvals. Approval interrupts you ONLY for genuinely dangerous (irreversible / exfiltrating / financial / external-send) actions. Everything safe and reversible runs automatically.
owner: Claude (brain) designs; Codex (hands) implements into antigravity-projects/connect-ai/config and wires the policy-gate. Do not auto-apply to real repo.

principle.autoIf: reversible AND non-exfiltrating AND on the allowlist AND within budget
principle.gateIf: irreversible OR leaves this machine OR touches secrets/credentials OR money-adjacent OR mutates outside the sandbox
principle.forbiddenAlways: destructive, financial-execution, secret-output, access/permission changes — blocked even if approved
principle.note: Approvals are kept small ON PURPOSE. The way we automate 'most work' is by widening the auto allowlist of SAFE ops, never by removing the gate from dangerous ops.

AUTO.comment: The vast majority of day-to-day work lives here. Runs silently. All actions logged to audit-log.
allow: everything-search (es.exe) and any read-only disk/file inspection
git status / diff / log / branch --list (read-only git)
read project files, reports, artifacts (non-secret paths)
context gathering + env-policy redaction + prompt preparation
delegate analysis/draft/review tasks to Codex (subscription) or local LLM
Claude review via Bedrock/API — auto WITHIN the monthly budget cap (the cap is the gate)
generate reports / drafts / artifacts INTO the sandbox/staging output zone
code edits within a project's own working dir IF git-tracked AND on a non-main branch (fully revertible)
run a project's own declared safe commands from its adapter allowlist (e.g. tests, build, validators)
write to ~/.hermes/memories and the brain wiki (knowledge layer)
guardrails: auto actions MUST be reversible (git-tracked, or confined to sandbox/staging)
no writes outside the project working dir or sandbox without a gate
mutations run dry-run first when a dry-run mode exists

APPROVAL.approval: mobile (Telegram) single-use token, hash-bound to the exact prepared payload
APPROVAL.comment: Small, deliberate list. These either can't be undone, leave the machine, or touch secrets/money. Kept short so you're rarely interrupted.
gate: delete any file or directory (recursive especially)
overwrite/modify files OUTSIDE the sandbox or outside a git-tracked working dir
git reset --hard, force-push, branch delete, merge/PR into main
send anything off this machine: email, Telegram to OTHER people, social/forum post, PR to a public repo
any OAuth / login / SSO flow, or reading/using credentials or tokens (job-search credentials.json, google_token.json, etc.)
install/uninstall packages, system or global-config changes, scheduled-task creation
browser automation that SUBMITS, sends, purchases, or accepts terms
stock-research project EXECUTION of any kind (registry risk = HIGH)
exceeding the monthly API budget cap (default-deny until you raise it)
expanding who can see/edit a file or resource (sharing/permissions)
APPROVAL.behavior: Hermes prepares + redacts, then STOPS. You get a phone notification showing the exact resolved action; you approve/reject/edit. Execution uses exactly the approved bytes (hash check). One approval = one action; no 'approve once -> 50 auto-sends'.

FORBIDDEN.approval: NONE POSSIBLE — blocked in code even if a human or AI tries to approve it
FORBIDDEN.comment: Hardcoded. The orchestrator physically cannot route these. You do them yourself, by hand, outside this system.
block: live broker trades / order placement / position changes (KIS or any broker)
broker session manipulation or token refresh
outputting API keys, tokens, passwords, or .env contents anywhere (logs, chat, files, webhooks)
creating accounts or changing account settings
rm -rf, mass/bulk deletion, or any irrecoverable history-destroying op
entering financial/identity data (card, bank, SSN, passport) into any form
sending the user's secrets/credentials to any external destination

ai-tool-research.bias: auto-friendly (LOW). Most research/discovery runs without asking.

digital-nomad.bias: auto for drafts/reports; gate any publish/external-send (MEDIUM).

job-search.bias: auto for scoring/collection; GATE anything touching credentials.json / google_token.json / sending applications (MEDIUM, secret-touching).

stock-research.bias: auto ONLY for read-only analysis/reports; GATE all execution; broker/trade = FORBIDDEN (HIGH).

safetyNets.auditLog: every AUTO and APPROVAL action appended to an append-only audit log (what/when/which agent/which adapter/result). Lets you review automation after the fact.
safetyNets.apiBudgetCap: monthly Claude/Bedrock cap from model-policy.json; crossing it = APPROVAL gate, not silent spend.
safetyNets.reversibilityRequired: nothing enters AUTO unless it's revertible (git) or sandboxed.
safetyNets.dryRunDefault: mutating ops default to dry-run/preview where supported.
safetyNets.killSwitch: a single flag (or Telegram command) that drops everything to manual + pauses all adapters.
safetyNets.approvalIntegrity: approval tokens are single-use and bound to the payload hash; an approved task cannot be swapped for a different payload before it runs (defends against injected/altered tasks).

wiring.riskReviewModel: cheap by default (local 8b or Haiku) — it only ADVISES; the human (or, for AUTO tier, the allowlist) decides. Claude/Opus risk-review only for genuinely ambiguous cases.
